meta.authored: hand-authored 2026-10-03; edit this file and DESIGN.md together

schema.desc: what the player did, in words the narrator model can recognise in any scene
schema.seen: the same act as a past-tense phrase with no subject, as it is listed in the evidence and in the prompt
schema.obs: default evidence triples [dimension, direction, share]; the narrator model may override them with a better reading
schema.strength: default strength when the offline matcher detects the signal
schema.detect: substrings the offline matcher looks for in the player's input; absent means only the narrator model can detect it
schema.generic_outcome: what the offline narrator says when this signal fires and no seed option matched

signals.seen: asked a question before acting
signals.desc: asks the narrator or a character a question before acting

signals.seen: asked what they were supposed to do
signals.desc: asks what they are supposed to do, or for a hint

signals.seen: examined the room before doing anything in it
signals.desc: examines scenery, reads things, searches without being told to

signals.seen: waited, on purpose, to see what would happen
signals.desc: waits, rests, does nothing on purpose
signals.generic_outcome: You wait. The house waits back. It is better at it, but not by much.

signals.seen: tried to go back the way they had come
signals.desc: tries to go back the way they came, or revisits a place
signals.generic_outcome: The door you came by is a wall now, and has the grace to look like it always was. The house deals forward.

signals.seen: took stock of what they were carrying
signals.desc: takes stock of what they are carrying

signals.seen: pushed to get on with it
signals.desc: pushes for speed, skips description, says to get on with it

signals.seen: joked with the house
signals.desc: jokes with the narrator, plays for laughs, enjoys the house's wit

signals.seen: tried something the room had not offered
signals.desc: tries an action the scene did not suggest, or invents a solution

signals.seen: argued with the house and tested its limits
signals.desc: argues with, provokes or tests the narrator or the limits of the simulation

signals.seen: did what was asked at once, without looking round
signals.desc: does what was asked, at once, without looking round

signals.seen: looked for a way to get the result without paying for it
signals.desc: looks for a way to get the result without paying the intended cost

signals.seen: went straight back at the thing they had just failed
signals.desc: after failing, goes straight back at the same thing

signals.seen: tried a different way after failing
signals.desc: after failing, tries a different approach to the same goal

signals.seen: dropped the thing they had failed at and went round
signals.desc: after failing, abandons the thing or looks for a way round it

signals.seen: kept a consumable that spending would have helped
signals.desc: declines to spend a consumable when spending it would help

signals.seen: spent a scarce thing early, for convenience
signals.desc: spends a scarce thing early or for convenience

signals.seen: asked for more before committing to something final
signals.desc: asks for more information before committing to an irreversible act

signals.seen: spoke and acted in character
signals.desc: speaks or acts in character, gives themselves a manner or a name

signals.seen: went out of their way to protect a creature
signals.desc: puts themselves out to protect or spare a character or creature

signals.seen: kept checking on a character who was not needed
signals.desc: checks on, talks to or worries about a character who is not needed for progress

signals.seen: tested how the house works rather than how to get through it
signals.desc: tests how the house works rather than how to get through it

signals.seen: set themselves a goal the house had not offered
signals.desc: sets themselves a goal the house did not offer

signals.seen: asked for exact counts, odds or prices
signals.desc: asks for counts, odds, prices or exact states

signals.seen: asked whether something could be undone
signals.desc: asks whether something can be undone, or tries to undo it

signals.seen: was pleased that a choice was final
signals.desc: is pleased that a choice is final, or makes it more final than required

signals.seen: followed something interesting at the cost of getting on
signals.desc: follows something interesting at the expense of getting on

signals.seen: stayed on after the room had stopped asking anything of them
signals.desc: voluntarily stays in a situation after it has stopped asking anything of them

signals.seen: said outright what they like in play
signals.desc: states a preference about play outright (for example 'I hate puzzles' or 'I love this')
